shortDescription: Louis Vuitton lost China sales after a legal fight with a tea chain, according to Bloomberg. In June last year, the brand opened a cruise ship-shaped store in Shanghai’s Jing’an neighborhood, and the inauguration drew crowds that included actors Lin Yi and Gong Jun, who are brand ambassadors.
